patthana19.5:1.1: na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
